dt: Applications and letters complete by 11:59 PM ET, Dec 4, 2026
e: Competitive fellowship for assistant-professor-level experimental physicists with 2+ years past PhD to do self-directed research on a Fermilab experiment; 3-year term, renewable 2 years, with possible later appointment without term limit. This year emphasizes neutrino, muon and collider physics; no citizenship restriction stated.
